usage: usegit.py [-h] [--project PROJECT]
                 {init,doctor,status,next,audit,template,record,authorize,invalidate,set-mode}
                 ...

Evidence-backed UseGit workflow controller. Python 3.10+, standard library
only. Only this controller writes .usegit/state.json. Reports and evidence are
supplied by the agent; validation establishes consistency, not the truth of
human claims.

positional arguments:
  {init,doctor,status,next,audit,template,record,authorize,invalidate,set-mode}
    init                Initialize isolated workflow state
    authorize           Register specific permission already received; never
                        grants permission itself

options:

  --project PROJECT     Customer project root (default: current directory)
